_comment: Generic coding-agent lesson corpus + QA set for bench/coding_agent_qa.py. No external dataset text, no product/vendor names. Lessons are pre-extracted (caller-decided saves), mirroring the bug_triage corpus shape. Each lesson is a memory row keyed by `memory_key`; questions carry `gold_keys` (the lesson keys that SHOULD rank at small-k) + `question_type` from the taxonomy + an optional `fix_reuse` block for the fix-reuse metric. Extend by appending lessons + questions; keep gold_keys pointing at real lesson keys.

value.text: Null-pointer crash in the config parser when a section header had no body. Fixed by guarding the section-body lookup with an empty-check before indexing.
value.fix: Added `if not body: continue` before the dict index in parse_section().

value.text: Batch loader OOM-killed under fan-out because it materialized the full result set in memory. Fixed by streaming rows with a server-side cursor and a bounded buffer of 1000.
value.fix: Switched from fetchall() to a chunked cursor with buffer cap 1000.

value.text: Integration test test_search_roundtrip was flaky because it asserted on results before the async write had committed. Fixed by polling an eventually-consistent helper instead of a fixed sleep.
value.fix: Replaced time.sleep(2) with an _eventually() poll loop, 10x500ms.

value.text: CI Docker build failed on arm64 runners because the base image only published amd64 tags. Fixed by pinning a multi-arch base image and adding a platform matrix to the build workflow.
value.fix: Pinned multi-arch base + added platforms: [amd64, arm64] to the build job.
value.error: exec format error / no matching manifest for linux/arm64

value.text: Adding a NOT NULL column without a default broke deploys because existing rows had no value. Fixed by splitting the migration: add nullable, backfill in batches, then add the NOT NULL constraint.
value.fix: Three-step migration: nullable add -> batched backfill -> set NOT NULL.

value.text: Token validation logic was duplicated across three handlers. Refactored it into a single auth middleware so JWT scope checks live in one place.
value.fix: Extracted validate_scope() into auth/middleware.py; handlers call the middleware.

value.text: Team convention: we standardize on asyncio for all async code. Do not introduce a second event-loop runtime. New blocking IO must be wrapped, not run on a different runtime.
Team convention: ruff is the only formatter and linter. No black, no isort as a separate tool. Line length is 100.
Release v2.3 shipped on 2026-04-08. It included the streaming batch loader fix, the multi-arch CI build, and the auth-middleware refactor.
value.fix: Tag v2.3 cut from main after the three landings merged.

value.text: Root cause of the stale-cache incident: the cache key omitted the tenant id, so two tenants collided. Identified during session on 2026-03-30.
value.error: Cross-tenant data leak via shared cache entry

value.text: Fix for the stale-cache incident: cache key now includes tenant id and namespace. Landed 2026-03-31.
value.fix: build_cache_key() now prefixes (tenant, namespace) into the key.

value.text: Post-mortem of the stale-cache incident: added a contract test asserting cache keys are tenant-scoped, plus a lint rule forbidding raw cache.set without a key builder. Action items closed 2026-04-02.
Connection pool exhaustion under sustained load because connections acquired in a request handler were never returned on the exception path. Fixed by wrapping acquisition in a context manager.
value.fix: Wrapped pool.acquire() in `async with` so release runs on every exit path.
value.error: TimeoutError: pool exhausted, all 20 connections in use
